transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Can we pause for a second? I think we’re spiraling a bit. What’s the one thing we deliver better than the other team? And who here has the clearest vision to lead that—based on what we’ve actually built, not just who wants it?

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: If I look at how we handle reporting, I'd say we're much more consistent than the other team. We actually verify before sending things out. That stands out. I don't think that's something they've matched yet.

transcript.name: Dr. Mei-Ling Chen
transcript.text: I’d like to hear from a few more people before we settle on anything. Maya, can you share your perspective? And if anyone disagrees with what’s been said, please jump in. We need all the cards on the table.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Enough. We’re not leaving this room without an answer. We lead because we deliver, not because we wait for consensus. I’ll take ownership—unless someone can tell me, right now, why they’re better suited. Speak up or move on.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Can I just check—does anyone here actually disagree with Natasha leading? Or is it more about wanting to talk through the risks a bit more? I just want to make sure we’re not skipping over something important.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: If we’re saying our strength is consistency and verified reporting, then whoever leads has to actually keep that up. Natasha’s good at pushing things forward, but I want to make sure details don’t get lost. If we go with her, I’d like to help double-check the process so we don’t drop the ball.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: If Natasha leads, maybe we can have someone else focus on verifying the details—reporting, QA, that stuff. I don’t mind pitching in there. Just to keep things tight.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Can I just check, if Natasha leads, do we have someone making sure the details are double-checked before anything goes out? I just want to be sure we’re keeping that standard high.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: If we're keeping Natasha in front, I can help out with documentation or checking the data before anything goes out. Just let me know where you want me.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Just to be sure, can we actually list out who’s double-checking the reporting? I know Natasha will push things, but it’d help me if we’re all clear on who handles which part. I’d rather ask now than drop something important.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: If we just jot down who’s checking what, I think we’re set. I can take final review on reporting, if that helps. Who else is on which piece?

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: I can jot down who’s handling which part if that helps. Just say what you’re taking on and I’ll make a quick list so we’re clear.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I can take care of checking backend logs or any API issues before we send out reports. Just let me know if that covers what’s needed.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Looks like we’ve got most things covered. If there’s anything open that still needs someone, I can help out. Just let me know where you need me.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: I can help with reviewing the compliance side before things go out, if that’s useful. Just let me know which reports or docs you want me to double-check.

transcript.name: Dr. Mei-Ling Chen
transcript.text: We have a lot of hands up to help, which is great. Can we just go down the list—Natasha leads, Todd final review on reporting, Amitesh checks backend logs, Wei covers compliance, Trang helps with documentation? Lucia, anything specific you want to own? If we can lock this in now, there won’t be loose ends.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Lucía, enough circling. Pick a piece and say it. Everyone else—if you have an objection, say it now. Otherwise, this is the team and these are the roles. We’re done debating.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Lucía, are you okay with how this is shaking out? If there’s something you’d rather handle, just say. I think we’re close, but want to be sure everyone’s good before we call it.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Enough. Lucía, make your call. Everyone else, we’re done—no more revisiting. If you want in, claim it. Otherwise, we move. I’m closing this out in thirty seconds.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Just say what you want, Lucía, and let's finish this. Everyone else okay with what they've got?

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Before we wrap, does anyone else have questions or concerns? Just want to make sure nothing’s left hanging. If you’re good, say so—if not, now’s the time.

transcript.name: Dr. Mei-Ling Chen
transcript.text: Last call—if anyone’s holding back a concern, say it now. Otherwise, I’m good with this plan and the roles as they stand. Lucía, just confirm you’re set.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I’ll take documentation. I’m comfortable making sure our notes and process are clear. Unless someone else wants it, I’m good with that.
